# Origin server performance tuning for concurrent web traffic
net.core.somaxconn = 65535
net.ipv4.tcp_max_syn_backlog = 65535
net.core.netdev_max_backlog = 65535
net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range = 1024 65535
net.ipv4.tcp_tw_reuse = 1
net.ipv4.tcp_fin_timeout = 10
net.ipv4.tcp_keepalive_time = 60
net.ipv4.tcp_keepalive_intvl = 10
net.ipv4.tcp_keepalive_probes = 6
net.ipv4.tcp_max_tw_buckets = 2000000
net.ipv4.tcp_syncookies = 1
net.core.rmem_max = 16777216
net.core.wmem_max = 16777216
net.ipv4.tcp_rmem = 4096 87380 16777216
net.ipv4.tcp_wmem = 4096 65536 16777216

[Service]
LimitNOFILE=65535
LimitNOFILESoft=65535

/var/log/nginx/*.log {
    daily
    rotate 7
    size 500M
    compress
    delaycompress
    missingok
    notifempty
    sharedscripts
    postrotate
        nginx -s reopen
    endscript
}

[Journal]
SystemMaxUse=200M
RuntimeMaxUse=50M

import json

def seeded_ids() -> dict:
    """Create absent bounded synthetic fixtures and return actual database identities."""
    result = subprocess.run(

def login(email: str, password: str) -> str:
    """Collect an origin-issued token using the public seeded account contract."""
    request = Request(
        "http://127.0.0.1:18888/identity/api/auth/login",
        data=json.dumps({"email": email, "password": password}).encode(),
        headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
    )
    with urlopen(request, timeout=10) as response:  # noqa: S310 - fixed loopback HTTP origin
        token = json.load(response).get("token")
    if not isinstance(token, str) or not token:
        message = "synthetic origin login failed"
        raise ValueError(message)
    return token

def dvwa_sessions(username="admin") -> dict:
    """Authenticate synthetic sessions on native origin replicas and share their PHP store."""
    import http.cookiejar
    import re
    from urllib.request import build_opener, HTTPCookieProcessor
    sessions = {}
    for domain, port in (("www.f5-sales-demo.com", 8101), ("api.f5-sales-demo.com", 8102)):
        jar = http.cookiejar.CookieJar()
        opener = build_opener(HTTPCookieProcessor(jar))
        base = "http://127.0.0.1:" + str(port)
        with opener.open(base + "/login.php", timeout=10) as response:
            html = response.read().decode()
        token = re.search(r"name=['\"]user_token['\"].*?value=['\"]([^'\"]+)", html)
        if token is None:
            raise ValueError("DVWA login token missing")
        request = Request(base + "/login.php", data=urlencode({"username": username, "password": "password", "Login": "Login", "user_token": token[1]}).encode(), headers={"Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"})
        with opener.open(request, timeout=10) as response:
            body = response.read().decode()
        if "Logout" not in body:
            raise ValueError("DVWA synthetic authentication failed")
        session = next((cookie.value for cookie in jar if cookie.name == "PHPSESSID"), None)
        if not session:
            raise ValueError("DVWA authenticated cookie missing")
        sessions[domain] = session
    return sessions

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Recover only repeatedly unresponsive, exactly pinned demo DVGA replicas."""
import json, pathlib, subprocess, time, urllib.request
IMAGE = "dolevf/dvga@sha256:040aa33c199d99f3380c9ff9a1ee5d725e9abca7b189c63a35a2a73bda79c957"
STATE = pathlib.Path("/var/lib/demo-dvga-recovery.json")
state = json.loads(STATE.read_text()) if STATE.exists() else {}
for index in range(1, 5):
    container_name = "dvga-" + str(index)
    inspected = subprocess.run(["/usr/bin/docker", "inspect", container_name], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True, timeout=10)
    container = json.loads(inspected.stdout)[0]
    labels = container["Config"].get("Labels", {}) or {}
    if labels.get("org.f5.demo.application") != "dvga" or labels.get("org.f5.demo.base-sha256") != IMAGE.split("sha256:")[1] or container["Name"] != "/" + container_name or labels.get("com.docker.compose.project") != "origin-server" or labels.get("com.docker.compose.service") != container_name or labels.get("com.docker.compose.project.working_dir") != "/opt/origin-server":
        raise ValueError("owned DVGA replica identity mismatch")
    try:
        request = urllib.request.Request("http://127.0.0.1:" + str(5200 + index) + "/graphql", data=b'{"query":"query getPastes { pastes(public: true, limit: 1) { id } }"}', headers={"Content-Type":"application/json"})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=3) as response:
            healthy = bool(json.load(response).get("data", {}).get("pastes"))
    except (OSError, ValueError):
        healthy = False
    prior = state.get(container_name, {"failures":0, "last_restart":0})
    prior["failures"] = 0 if healthy else prior["failures"] + 1
    if prior["failures"] >= 3 and time.time() - prior["last_restart"] >= 300:
        subprocess.run(["/usr/bin/docker", "restart", container_name], check=True, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, timeout=30)
        prior.update(failures=0, last_restart=time.time())
    state[container_name] = prior
STATE.write_text(json.dumps(state))
STATE.chmod(0o600)
